pooling_rule.binary_rates: recomputed from all replicate-level p-values; MCSE=sqrt(p*(1-p)/R)
pooling_rule.coefficient_means: mean over all replicate-level coefficients; MCSE=sample_sd/sqrt(R)
pooling_rule.first_stage_fe_design: two reference-panel diagnostics retained separately by master seed; no pseudo-MCSE is reported

scope: Synthetic DGP diagnostics only; no real-company data are used, calibrated, or implied.
